## Why

Describe the problem and who the change helps.

## What changed

Describe the resulting behavior and the main implementation choices.

## Scope

State what this PR includes and any deferred work.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Link the actual test or runtime output.

## Evidence

For UI changes, include screenshots and a recording of the changed flow. For nonvisual changes, replace both media sections with an explanation beginning with `Visual evidence does not apply because`, and link the test or runtime output.

### Screenshots

Paste Markdown images hosted at HTTPS URLs. Include the relevant viewport sizes.

### Screen recording

Link an HTTPS recording that shows the changed flow and its result.

### Runtime verification and limitations

Name the environment and tested revision. Distinguish real provider verification from test fixtures or simulated responses. State what you verified and any remaining setup or unverified behavior.
